Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs two distinct MS strategies: a large-scale DIA-MS analysis for plasma proteome profiling (using SIS spike-ins for quantification) and a DDA-MS analysis for the spike protein pulldown (AP-MS). The primary quantitative workflow is DIA.

scope: A magnetic affinity pulldown of a His-tagged SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein mixed with plasma from COVID-19 ICU patients was coupled with proteomics to determine interaction partners.
His-tagged spike was then isolated by means of metal affinity magnetic beads (Dynabeads His-Tag Isolation and Pulldown, 10103D, ThermoFisher) and eluted in imidazole-containing phosphate buffer.
Proteins in the pulldown isolates were denatured, reduced, alkylated and precipitated, as described above.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The input text describes two types of proteomics: a general plasma proteome analysis (DIA-MS) and a specific spike protein pulldown (DDA-MS). Following the precedence rules, the affinity-purified material (spike pulldown) is prioritized as a 'purified protein or complex' over the general plasma/serum analysis.
